id: title:VojtechBartos:stop duplicating thread messages in agent context

review.posthog_relevance: Slack App ingestion and message quality preservation
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 implements a production change in the Slack App ingestion agent. It adds a filter to skip Slack message blocks of type 'rich_text' while retaining the original 'text' field. This preserves mentions and emoji in the downstream prompt, preventing the ingestion of flattened, degraded content. observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check to skip Slack message blocks of type 'rich_text' while retaining the original 'text' field, and adds corresponding unit tests.
observations.code_quote: blocks = [b for b in blocks if not (isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("type") == "rich_text")]
observations.posthog_connection: This prevents the Slack message ingestion agent from receiving a flattened, near-duplicate version of the message text that loses mentions and emoji, while retaining the original text which preserves them. This could improve the quality of the agent's prompt and prevent duplicate or degraded content from reaching downstream processing.
